hook: Whitworth arrived at privacy from communications law, FCC staff, telecom practice, online business counsel, before building a financial-sector privacy career that now spans one of the largest U.S. bank mergers. At Truist he oversees global privacy, technology compliance, and AI compliance across the full institution and its affiliates, making him an early practitioner of the combined privacy-AI governance function that regulators are now formalizing.
name: Ron Whitworth

quote.text: Ron Whitworth is Chief Privacy Officer at Truist in Charlotte, N.C., managing the Enterprise Privacy and Technology Office within Compliance Risk Management.

timeline.event: Special Assistant to FCC Commissioner Jonathan Adelstein
timeline.impact: Enters communications law and federal regulatory practice

timeline.event: Attorney at Fletcher, Heald and Hildreth
timeline.impact: Builds telecommunications and communications law expertise

timeline.event: Attorney at Sullivan and Worcester LLP
timeline.impact: Adds privacy, data security, and online business practice

timeline.event: Senior Privacy Counsel then CPO at EverBank
Chief Privacy Officer at SunTrust, then Truist post-merger
timeline.impact: Leads enterprise privacy and AI compliance at top-ten U.S. bank
Advises federal government on privacy and data integrity policy

quick_facts: Chief Privacy Officer at Truist Financial Corporation, managing the Enterprise Privacy and Technology Office (EPTO) for global privacy, technology, and AI compliance
Fellow of Information Privacy (FIP) and Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP)
Holds five IAPP certifications: CIPP/US, CIPP/C, CIPP/E, CIPM, and AIGP
Appointed by the Secretary of the Department of Homeland Security to the Data Privacy and Integrity Advisory Committee (DPIAC) in 2018; served three terms
Former attorney at Sullivan and Worcester LLP and Special Assistant to FCC Commissioner Jonathan Adelstein

achievements.title: Chief Privacy Officer, Truist
achievements.impact: Manages the Enterprise Privacy and Technology Office with responsibility for global privacy, technology compliance, and AI compliance across Truist Financial and all subsidiaries.

achievements.title: DHS Data Privacy and Integrity Advisory Committee, three terms
achievements.impact: Appointed by the Secretary of Homeland Security to advise on PII, data integrity, privacy, and cybersecurity policy affecting federal programs.

achievements.title: Chief Privacy Officer and Associate General Counsel, EverBank
achievements.impact: Built the privacy and data security function at a federally chartered bank before its acquisition.

achievements.title: Privacy and telecom practice, Sullivan and Worcester LLP
achievements.impact: Counseled clients on U.S. and international privacy and data security, telecommunications, and online business matters.
